[1/1] Harden the data-directory lock: an unopenable lock file raises StorageLockError with a clear message instead of an uncaught PermissionError

impact_assessment.why: StorageEngine.locked opens .lock outside the retry loop, but main catches only StorageLockError; a read-only or invalid data directory therefore prints a traceback instead of the CLI's Error line
impact_assessment.benefits: Every lock failure, not just contention, exits 1 with the same clear error and no traceback; the CLI contract stays consistent
impact_assessment.risks: contract: lock contention behavior unchanged, new error path only; dependency: none; concurrency: same lock, no new lock; state: no schema change
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first mock test for PermissionError on open, full 71-test suite, aikit check chronos 4/4, commit and push
